validation_results.failure: Dig did not reach its bounded PP gate after Diglett fainted before attacking Raichu.
validation_results.diagnosis: The Dig-only controller carried one Super Potion. This legal high-damage branch consumed it before Raichu, then entered another turn below a survivable HP threshold and fainted before the selected Dig could execute.

interpretation.planner_result: All objective decisions before the failure were model-authorized; the failure occurred in bounded battle recovery rather than objective selection.
interpretation.evaluation_result: The preregistered v6 series failed its five-run completion contract and is retired. The exposed-seed repair completion cannot replace a held-out result.
interpretation.repair_result: Vermilion preparation now carries a two-use Super Potion budget, and the Dig-only controller may spend both at semantic low-HP MAIN gates while preserving the off-slot PP invariant.
interpretation.next_gate: Run the unchanged repaired source and model on the fresh v7 validation schedules, leaving v7 test schedules sealed.
